---
title: Quarto 1.11 migration
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: gold
    type: memo
    kind: note
    memo:
      to: Data team
      from: M. Canouil
      date: 11 Nov 2026
    footer:
      left: Internal
      centre: Memo 2026-07
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: A note memo has the banner with its kind label, the to, from and date rows in a table, and the band on its page.
        check: bash _checks/memo.sh kind note gold
    mcanouil-typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['mcanouil-document\(\s*"memo",\s*"standard",\s*"note"']
---

{{< include _note.qmd >}}
